story.fullStory:
Mary Hopkin's "Goodbye" reached #13 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Goodbye" is a song written by Paul McCartney (but credited to Lennon–McCartney) and performed by Mary Hopkin.

The song peaked at #13 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 9 weeks on the chart.

Goodbye was released in 1969.
